error[ZBX-E0213]: a --mount needs the container to run as root
  while  checking the user of a run with --mount
  cause  the container would run as app:staff (uid 1000, gid 50), and what it
         writes through --mount would belong to an id that is not yours
  uid    1000
  gid    50
  fix    run it as root, which is you inside the container:   zbx run --user 0 --mount ./site:/srv <image>
         or give the directory read-only:                     zbx run --bind ./site:/srv <image>
  more   zbx explain E0213
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigbox/errors/E0213.html
